mechanism_narrative: A high current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses corporate profit margins and increases discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, the S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that reduces liquidity and increases borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, the S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% combined with high inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 315.0 signals a stagflationary regime, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 5.0% AND CPIAUCSL > 315.0, the S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS rising above 4.5% and sustained for 3 months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns due to reduced liquidity and higher discount rates, with a 20-day horizon.
failure_condition: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and sustained for 3 months), the S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1300.0 thousand units signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 1300.0, the S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 signals a contraction in the supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 100.0, the S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A strong retail sales figure (RSAFS) above 720,000 million dollars signals robust consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS > 720000, the S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS above 159,000 thousand) signals robust economic growth and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS > 159000, the S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.
